realm.success: min(1,0.65+0.08*failures); guaranteed on attempt after 5 failures
realm.fail_consume: consume cost, keep level and XP; no regression
realm.quality_trial: generated trial against own template, 1 enemy, min_level=realm*20+1; no stamina charge on trial, no repeat loot
realm.overflow_xp: bank XP until breakthrough, no automatic spend on failure

rules.talent_roll: one fixed talent plus one random on first ownership; duplicate does not reroll; no reroll system until separately approved

rules.reset: each counter resets only if obtained tier >= its threshold
rules.draw_order: highest triggered guarantee first, else weighted tier; renormalize eligible tier weights; uniform within tier; no empty tier
rules.version_identity: one owned instance per template; duplicate same template grants shards; separate versions may be owned but only one identity per active team (proposed)
rules.map_recruit: quest or territory reward may grant shards/whole ninja; all acquisitions same duplicate handler
